newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares edge up, more gains dependent on Dow.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares edge up, more gains dependent on Dow.

text.p: Danish share prices closed a little higher again on Thursday, following foreign trends, with dealers seeing more gains ahead of the weekend, provided the Dow Jones continues on its current upward path.
"The market is up primarily because of rises on overseas bourses. If the U.S. continues upwards, Denmark will follow suit tomorrow," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index gained 0.38 point to close at 189.18 in overall bourse turnover of 1.320 billion crowns. The KFX August future rose 0.30 point to 189.70 with 532 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
A.P. Moeller's D/S Svendborg and D/S 1912 reached new record heights, putting on 3,000 and 2,000 crowns respectively to close at 438,000 and 302,000.
Novo Nordisk recovered from a recent wave of falls to close eight crowns higher at 738, after dropping from an earlier 751.
